result.title: Quantile Propagation Planning for Budgeted Tail-Risk Evaluation
result.summary: Risk-aware planning must identify rare, costly outcomes using only a limited number of model evaluations. Monte Carlo rollouts spend this budget on noisy tail estimates, while planning from the mean can miss the tail entirely. We introduce quantile propagation planning (QPP), which propagates a small, fixed set of disturbance quantiles through the dynamics and integrates the resulting cost curve to evaluate both mean and tail risk. The method is exact at the propagated levels, converges as the quantile grid is refined, and admits a one-sided conservatism guarantee under stated structural conditions. In controlled overload and inventory tasks, QPP reduces realized tail cost and constraint violations relative to mean-rollout planning. On overload, it remains competitive with sampled evaluators that use substantially more trajectories. These results position QPP as a transparent, budget-controlled approach to tail-risk evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 quantile propagation planning（QPP）：把少量固定扰动分位点沿动力学传播并积分所得代价曲线，在有限评估预算下同时评估均值与尾部风险，给出传播层精确性、网格细化收敛与单侧保守性保证，并在过载与库存任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 用固定少量分位点做确定性信念／扰动传播，可能为 LVR 中有限算力下的 latent 状态传播与计算分配提供概念类比，其与粒子滤波式状态抽象、预算受限评价的具体对应可供核查。
